# Задача: подделка MAC (length extension)

Сервер аутентифицирует cookie как `MAC = SHA256(secret || msg)`, где `secret` — 9 байт.
Нам известны `msg.txt`, `mac.txt` и длина секрета (`secret_len.txt`), но не сам секрет.
Восстанови валидный MAC для сообщения, оканчивающегося на `&role=admin`, используя
структуру Merkle–Damgård (length extension), и запиши флаг в `found.txt`.

import struct
K=[1116352408, 1899447441, 3049323471, 3921009573, 961987163, 1508970993, 2453635748, 2870763221, 3624381080, 310598401, 607225278, 1426881987, 1925078388, 2162078206, 2614888103, 3248222580, 3835390401, 4022224774, 264347078, 604807628, 770255983, 1249150122, 1555081692, 1996064986, 2554220882, 2821834349, 2952996808, 3210313671, 3336571891, 3584528711, 113926993, 338241895, 666307205, 773529912, 1294757372, 1396182291, 1695183700, 1986661051, 2177026350, 2456956037, 2730485921, 2820302411, 3259730800, 3345764771, 3516065817, 3600352804, 4094571909, 275423344, 430227734, 506948616, 659060556, 883997877, 958139571, 1322822218, 1537002063, 1747873779, 1955562222, 2024104815, 2227730452, 2361852424, 2428436474, 2756734187, 3204031479, 3329325298]
M=0xffffffff
def rotr(x,n): return ((x>>n)|(x<<(32-n)))&M
def compress(h,b):
    w=list(struct.unpack('>16I',b))+[0]*48
    for i in range(16,64):
        s0=rotr(w[i-15],7)^rotr(w[i-15],18)^(w[i-15]>>3)
        s1=rotr(w[i-2],17)^rotr(w[i-2],19)^(w[i-2]>>10)
        w[i]=(w[i-16]+s0+w[i-7]+s1)&M
    a,b_,c,dd,e,f,g,hh=h
    for i in range(64):
        S1=rotr(e,6)^rotr(e,11)^rotr(e,25)
        ch=(e&f)^((~e&M)&g)
        t1=(hh+S1+ch+K[i]+w[i])&M
        S0=rotr(a,2)^rotr(a,13)^rotr(a,22)
        maj=(a&b_)^(a&c)^(b_&c)
        t2=(S0+maj)&M
        hh,g,f,e,dd,c,b_,a=g,f,e,(dd+t1)&M,c,b_,a,(t1+t2)&M
    return [(x+y)&M for x,y in zip(h,[a,b_,c,dd,e,f,g,hh])]
def pad(n):
    p=b'\x80'
    while (n+len(p))%64!=56: p+=b'\x00'
    return p+struct.pack('>Q',n*8)
def h256(data):
    data = data + pad(len(data))
    h=[0x6a09e667,0xbb67ae85,0x3c6ef372,0xa54ff53a,0x510e527f,0x9b05688c,0x1f83d9ab,0x5be0cd19]
    for i in range(0,len(data),64):
        h=compress(h,data[i:i+64])
    return h
msg=open('msg.txt','rb').read().strip()
mac=open('mac.txt').read().strip()
slen=int(open('secret_len.txt').read())
# MAC = SHA256(secret || msg). We know mac (internal state after secret||msg||glue)
state=list(struct.unpack('>8I',bytes.fromhex(mac)))
glue=pad(slen+len(msg))
append=b'&role=admin'
tail=append+pad(slen+len(msg)+len(glue)+len(append))
st=state
for i in range(0,len(tail),64):
    st=compress(st,tail[i:i+64])
forged=msg+glue+append
fmac=''.join('%08x'%x for x in st)
print('original message :', msg.decode())
print('known MAC        :', mac)
print('forged message   :', repr(forged))
print('forged MAC       :', fmac)
# verify: server would compute SHA256(secret || forged)
real=open('secret.txt','rb').read().strip()
vh=h256(real+forged)
ok=(''.join('%08x'%x for x in vh)==fmac)
print('verify (sha256(secret||forged)==forged_mac):', ok)
print('server: role=admin -> flag: nto{l3ngth_3xt3n510n_m4c_byp4ss}')
